What this fixes

A floor sample is counted only when its ray to the sun passes through this rectangular opening and is not blocked by the existing external geometry. The old open-space model could not enforce that.

This is geometric direct sun, not lux. Internal partitions, glazing transmission, curtains, reflections and unmodelled balcony slabs are still excluded.
